info.title: API.SH: DefiLlama
info.description: The DefiLlama API from API.SH: public DefiLlama data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/defillama-bridges

parameters.name: chart_days
parameters.description: Days of daily volume in `chart` (default 90; 0 = all).

get.description:
Fees and revenue by protocol or chain. Without `slug`: the market totals and every protocol ranked, each with fees and revenue for 24 hours, 7 and 30 days, a year and all time, changes, chains and methodology; all chains or one `chain`, optionally one category. With `slug`: that protocol's fees and revenue with changes, sub-protocols, methodology and the breakdown by chain. Pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/defillama-fees

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: One protocol (the name in defillama.com/fees/<slug>); omit for the ranked list.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: One chain (default all); with `slug`, only that chain's breakdown.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: List only: protocols of this category.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: List only: fees_24h (default), fees_7d, fees_30d, fees_1y, revenue_24h, revenue_7d, revenue_30d, revenue_1y, change_1d, change_7d or change_1m.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: List only: asc or desc (default desc).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: List only: page number, starting at 1.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Hacks and exploits of crypto protocols: date, name, classification, technique, amount lost and returned in USD, chains, bridge flag, target type and source. Filter by text, chain, technique, classification, target type, bridge hacks or date range; sort by date, amount or returned funds. Pass `next_page` back as `page`, null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/defillama-hacks

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Current or historical USD prices of tokens by contract address or CoinGecko id, with symbol, decimals, price time and confidence. Optionally each coin's percentage change over a period (`change_percent`) and a price chart (`chart`: time and price points) ending at `date` or now.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/defillama-prices

parameters.name: coins
parameters.description: Up to 100, comma-separated: chain:address (ethereum:0x..., solana:...) or coingecko:<id>.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Price at this time instead of now (ISO date or unix time).

parameters.name: search_width
parameters.description: How far from the requested time a price may be taken, e.g. 30m, 6h (default), 1d.

parameters.name: change_period
parameters.description: Adds `change_percent` per coin: the price change over this period ending at `date` or now, e.g. 1h, 24h, 7d, 4w.

parameters.name: chart_period
parameters.description: Adds `chart` per coin: one price every this interval, e.g. 1h, 1d, 1w, ending at `date` or now.

parameters.name: chart_points
parameters.description: With chart_period: number of points (1-500, default 30).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
DEX volume, protocol fees, options volume, DEX-aggregator volume or bridge-aggregator volume: market totals for 24 hours, 7 and 30 days, a year and all time with changes, and every protocol ranked with the same figures. All chains or one chain. Pass `next_page` back as `page`. `type=revenue` ranks protocol revenue; `data_type` picks the metric of a board (fees: fees, revenue or holders' revenue; options: premium or notional volume). The response carries the `data_type` used. `type=derivatives` ranks perpetuals (perps) volume and adds open interest per protocol and for the market, the 7-day-over-7-day and 30-day-over-30-day changes, the volume 7 and 30 days ago and a one-line market summary.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/defillama-volumes

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: dexs (default), fees, revenue (protocol revenue), options, aggregators, bridges or derivatives (perps).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: total_24h (default), total_7d, total_30d, total_1y, total_all_time, change_1d, change_7d, change_1m or open_interest (derivatives).

parameters.name: data_type
parameters.description: Metric to rank by: dailyVolume (dexs, aggregators, bridges, derivatives); dailyFees, dailyRevenue or dailyHoldersRevenue (fees, revenue); dailyPremiumVolume (default) or dailyNotionalVolume (options).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Yield pools across DeFi: chain, project, symbol, TVL, APY split into base and reward, 7-day base APY, 30-day mean, 1/7/30-day APY change, volume, stablecoin and impermanent-loss flags, exposure, outlier flag, DefiLlama's APY trend prediction, reward and underlying tokens. Filter and sort with every field the yields page offers. Pass `next_page` back as `page`. Also filter by impermanent-loss risk, outlier flag, pool label (`pool_meta`) and maximum TVL or APY. With `pool`, returns that one pool (`item`) and its daily `history` (date, TVL, APY, base and reward APY, 7-day base APY, 7-day impermanent loss).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/defillama-yields

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Only this project slug (aave-v3, lido, curve-dex ...).

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Only pools holding this token symbol.

parameters.name: stablecoin
parameters.description: true for stablecoin pools only, false for the rest.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: tvl (default), apy, apy_base, apy_reward, apy_mean_30d, apy_change_7d or volume_1d.

parameters.name: il_risk
parameters.description: yes or no: only pools with (or without) impermanent-loss risk.

parameters.name: outlier
parameters.description: true or false: only pools flagged (or not flagged) as APY outliers.

parameters.name: pool_meta
parameters.description: Only pools whose label contains this text (e.g. a lock period or a fee tier).

parameters.name: pool
parameters.description: One pool id (the `pool` of a result, e.g. 747c1d2a-c668-4682-b9f9-296708a3dd90): return that pool with its daily APY and TVL history instead of the list.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: With `pool`: days of history (default 365; 0 for all).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
